scope: Original immutable PRG executed in current bundled 6502/APU bus with explicit mapper0 mapping. init_sound; init_music song0; 230 controlled update_sound calls labelled one per NTSC video frame. No frontend NES2 loading, full-game timing, listening, hardware or new production decoder claim.
